tablet-834: invisibleImgs=1 = /images/site/Marker-Sample-2.jpg, computedDisplay block, parent display none, rect 0x0, naturalWidth 0, hero photo requests 0 (desktop-1440 control: 1). REFUTED — probe artifact, not a site defect. The single invisible is the desktop-only hero photograph inside (src/App.jsx:1890-1908). The computes display:none below lg, so the has a 0x0 rect; the crawler predicate reads getComputedStyle(img).display, which returns the img's OWN computed value ("block") rather than the parent's "none", and .closest("[hidden]") does not match a class named "hidden". Verified in the same run that the photo is also never REQUESTED at these widths: request interception counted 0 requests for /images/site/Marker-Sample-2.jpg at tablet-834 and at mobile-390, against 1 at desktop-1440 as the positive control (loading="lazy" on a display:none element never intersects). imgComplete=false, naturalWidth=0 at both small viewports.
